title: Exact floor extension right adjoint for arithmetic restriction of varying-ring systems
statement:
Let $\mathcal C$ be a small site and $B_1\leftarrow B_2\leftarrow\cdots$ sheaves of commutative rings. Let $\mathscr S(B)$ be the abelian category of strict semilinear systems of $B_k$-module sheaves, with componentwise exactness, and use its ordinary unbounded derived category [lem-pur-system-level-left-extension, def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Fix $e\geq1$, put $B_r=(B_{en})_{n\geq1}$ and let $U:\mathscr S(B)\to\mathscr S(B_r)$ retain the levels $en$. Restriction of scalars is as in [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars]. Define
$$ (JC)_k=\begin{cases}0&k<e,\\ \operatorname{Res}_{B_k\to B_{e\lfloor k/e\rfloor}} C_{\lfloor k/e\rfloor}&k\geq e.\end{cases} $$
Transitions are induced by those of $C$ when the floor index changes, are identities of underlying sheaves within each block, and are zero into the prefix $k<e$. This defines an additive exact functor $J$ right adjoint to $U$. The natural Hom bijection sends $f:D\to JC$ to $(f_{en}:D_{en}\to C_n)_n$; its inverse sends $g:UD\to C$ to the zero components below $e$ and the composites $D_k\to\operatorname{Res}D_{e\lfloor k/e\rfloor}\xrightarrow{\operatorname{Res}g_{\lfloor k/e\rfloor}}(JC)_k$ otherwise. One has $UJ=\mathrm{id}$, counit the identity, and the unit $D\to JUD$ has identity components at $en$.

The induced termwise functors preserve quasi-isomorphisms and give an adjunction $D(U)\dashv D(J)$ on the ordinary unbounded derived categories with these localized unit and counit [def-weil-exact-derived-adjunction]. If a ring sheaf $A$ has compatible maps to all $B_k$, let $\mathcal L_B$ and $\mathcal L_{B_r}$ be total derived inverse limit after forgetting scalars to $A$ [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-strict-tower-homotopy-limit]. There is a natural isomorphism $\mathcal L_B JC\cong\mathcal L_{B_r}C$ compatible with every selected limit projection. No exactness of countable products is assumed.
